L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.

L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).

L16: PCD shall transmit at 13.56 MHz ± 517 ppm with field strength 1.5 ≤ H ≤ 7.5 A/m.
L16: PCD shall use 100% ASK Modified Miller for Type A at 106 kbps.
L16: PCD shall use 10% ASK NRZ-L for Type B.
L16: PICC shall load-modulate the 847.5 kHz subcarrier with Manchester (Type A) or BPSK (Type B).
L16: Every Type A standard frame shall protect each byte with one odd-parity bit and the whole frame with CRC_A.
L16: PICC shall answer REQA / WUPA with ATQA within fdt_listen ≤ 86.43 μs.
L16: PCD anti-collision loop shall be bit-frame at CL1/CL2/CL3 with SEL = 0x93/0x95/0x97.
L16: Cascade Tag 0x88 shall appear in UID-CLn[0] of every non-final Cascade Level.
L16: BCC at each CL shall be UID-CLn[0] XOR UID-CLn[1] XOR UID-CLn[2] XOR UID-CLn[3].
L16: Final SELECT (NVB = 0x70) shall be followed by SAK + CRC_A.
L16: SAK b3 = 1 shall indicate UID-CLn[0] was the Cascade Tag.
L16: SAK b6 = 1 shall indicate ISO 14443-4 compliance.
L16: PICC shall transition to HALT on receipt of HLTA.
L16: Layer 4 RATS (0xE0) shall be followed by ATS reply.
L16: Layer 4 FWT shall obey FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI.
L16: T=CL block format shall use PCB + CID (optional) + NAD (optional) + INF + CRC_A.
L16: T=CL block number shall alternate 0/1 per direction.
L16: GetVersion shall be supported on Ultralight EV1 / Plus EV1/EV2 / DESFire EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light.
